title: arisaema costatum var. sikkimense
intro: Arisaema costatum var. sikkimense, commonly known as Himalayan Cobra Lily, is a plant species in the Arum family. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its therapeutic properties. The plant is believed to have health benefits such as lowering blood pressure and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Arisaema costatum var. sikkimense include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which are thought to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
